station_name: Santa Clara River near Santa Paula, Calif.
notes: Both printed blocks (same 9 sampling dates) are one digitized table. 9 dates x 22 value columns = 198 printed numbers (11 in upper block incl. mean discharge, 11 in lower block). Dissolved solids in tons per ac-ft restates dissolved solids in other units: 9 values not counted as measurements, so 189. Other distances in LOCATION: 1.5 miles upstream from Santa Paula bridge, 1.8 miles east of Santa Paula. Mean discharge is a computed difference between two other stations (remarks). Title says water year October 1967 to September 1968; samples are about monthly on single dates, so discrete.
